name: markdown-document
body: A markdown source file scanned as a document: its headings are sections (symbols) nested by heading level, and its links are references (Uses edges) to other documents/sections. The document is the unit the markdown frontend discovers and emits. Every document has exactly one document-root section Struct (representing the whole document and its preamble) contained by the File; each heading section is a Struct contained by the document-root or the nearest preceding lower-level heading. A section is a Struct because only Struct can contain Struct and only Struct can be a Uses/UnresolvedUse source or a Uses target under the graph schema — a Function cannot contain and a File is not a legal Uses endpoint; the document-root Struct is therefore what makes a whole document (or a heading-less document) a representable link source and target. Realised by the markdown frontend.
